material.value: Does CI parse js/client/widgets.js, so a syntax error would turn the static client job red?
material.witness_evidence: No. CI static job runs only node scripts/check-modulepreload.mjs (.github/workflows/ci.yml:66-79, dispatch 1792909937509-5026-56027c37f0135846); pages.yml only tests file existence. A syntax error would pass CI, so the edit is parse-checked locally with node --experimental-default-type=module --check (read-only parse, node v24.22.0).
